sources.fact: Current authoritative Brownfield entity is LBBD 77/DM, Dagenham Heathway Mall.
Current Brownfield capacity is 500 minimum and 860 maximum net dwellings on 2.79ha.
Ownership-status is owned-by-a-public-authority; this is not a current proprietor/title relation.
The record supplies a point and blank geometry, not an exact application or title polygon.
Cabinet on 16 February 2026 approved preparation of comprehensive development proposals for Heathway Mall and Millard Terrace and market testing with external partners.
The decision states that a future full business case is required and refers to works pending planning permission being secured.
Approximately 157 replacement social rented homes relate to Jervis Court/former British Legion and Brockelbank Lodge decant sites, not the DM Brownfield capacity.
The minutes identify Millard Terrace as an existing 156-unit estate; existing units are not added to DM future capacity.
The £65.242m HRA budget and assumed £39.250m GLA grant concern replacement-home decant delivery and are not a planning permission or land value for DM.
Reconfirmed CPO powers and vacant-possession actions are governance/acquisition steps, not current HMLR title proof or permission finality.
Regulation 19 HTML lists DM Heathway Mall as allocation provenance; plan-making is not a site permission.

examples.result: DM remains 500–860 net dwellings and not-permissioned in the current Brownfield record.
The 2026 redevelopment strategy is not treated as an issued planning permission.
Approximately 157 decant homes on separate sites are not added to DM capacity.
Existing 156 Millard Terrace homes are not counted as new DM dwellings.
Budget and grant figures are not converted into land value or consent evidence.
CPO/vacant-possession powers are not HMLR proprietor or title-extent proof.
Brownfield point is not converted into a legal polygon.
Promotion remains zero until exact current DM planning case, title relation and overlays are verified.
